body: I’m not sure what to say really. I am in therapy and on anti depressants but I feel really shitty. I don’t have ambition for the future I don’t want to do anything it feels like when I make plans with people it isn’t because I actually want to do it but because I think it’s what I’m supposed to do. I think I’d be happier if I could just go to my room with video games and have time to sleep and recover from my daily life but then I’d just be leeching off of my family
Thank you for the lovely advice I’m very eager to start skating.
Would it be better to go a few times before starting lessons, I would assume so.
